title: A computational framework for designing micron-scale crisscross DNA megastructures
authors: Aquilina M; Katzmeier F; Nijenhuis MA; Wang SS; Becker C; Zhao Y; Seok SH; Finkel J; Cui H; Lee J; Lee S; Shih WM
one_liner_zh: 该文开发计算框架设计DNA折纸巨型结构，虽涉及DNA序列优化与组装，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Crisscross polymerization enables the assembly of hundreds of unique DNA origami ‘slats’ into micron-sized structures with nanoscale precision. To design these megastructures, thousands of handle sequences from a fixed library must be assigned to individual slats to encode the desired binding architecture. This complexity presents two major challenges: handles must be selected to minimize parasitic interactions that compete with desired assembly, and the fabrication of hundreds of unique slats creates a substantial logistical burden. Here, we develop a unified framework that standardizes the design and fabrication of crisscross megastructures. We use an evolutionary algorithm to optimize handle assignment and minimize parasitic binding between slats, paired with a graph-based algorithm that expands the handle library. Together, these algorithms enable the assembly of large, multi-layered megastructures that otherwise would be produced at negligible yields. We have released this framework as #-CAD, an open-source graphical application that integrates these algorithms, streamlines laboratory workflows, and makes crisscross DNA origami more broadly accessible.
abstract_zh: 交叉聚合（crisscross polymerization）使得数百个独特的DNA折纸“板条”（slats）能够组装成具有纳米级精度的微米级结构。为了设计这些巨型结构，必须从固定库中分配数千个手柄序列（handle sequences）给各个板条，以编码所需的结合架构。这种复杂性带来了两大挑战：必须选择手柄以最小化与目标组装竞争的寄生相互作用，同时制造数百个独特板条也构成了巨大的后勤负担。在此，我们开发了一个统一框架，标准化了交叉聚合巨型结构的设计与制造。我们使用进化算法（evolutionary algorithm）优化手柄分配并最小化板条间的寄生结合，并配以基于图的算法（graph-based algorithm）扩展手柄库。这些算法共同使得大型多层巨型结构的组装成为可能，而这些结构若采用其他方法则产量极低。我们已将该框架发布为#-CAD，一个开源图形应用程序，它整合了这些算法，简化了实验室工作流程，并使交叉聚合DNA折纸技术更广泛地可及。
